subject.title: fix(azure): responses model aliases route correctly

question: Is the PR's local mock Responses-server OpenClaw probe sufficient proof for the Azure Responses auth-provider routing fix, or should merge wait for a live Azure credential probe?
rationale: The code path is resolver-owned and well covered, but auth-provider routing is compatibility-sensitive and live Azure credentials were not exercised.

options.title: Accept resolver-layer proof
options.body: Treat the mock Responses probe plus focused resolver tests as sufficient for this routing bug and proceed after exact-head CI.

options.title: Require live Azure probe
options.body: Ask for a redacted live Azure Responses probe before merge to prove the external credential exchange as well as route selection.

options.title: Reject this owner boundary
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want a broader provider contract change instead of endpoint-surface-based alias ownership.

recommendation.title: Accept resolver-layer proof
recommendation.body: Treat the mock Responses probe plus focused resolver tests as sufficient for this routing bug and proceed after exact-head CI.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history points to vincentkoc as the most recent contributor on the resolver and manifest alias surface, though original ownership is unclear from the shallow checkout.
